description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams' used for filtering search parameters related to 'likes' on shared content in the OrangeHRM Buzz module. It extends a base filter parameters class and specifies allowed sort fields and a share ID property with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShareSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering 'like' search results on shared posts, specifying sort options and share ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with a default sort field 'shareLike.likedAtUtc'.

methods.name: getShareId
methods.description: Returns the share ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setShareId
methods.description: Sets the share ID filter parameter.
